crossRefs.note: So the couriers went with the letters from the king and his princes throughout all Israel and Judah, and according to…

people.name: Asher
people.line: Son of Jacob and Zilpah, founder of the tribe of Asher

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

people.name: Naphtali
people.line: Son of Jacob, founder of the tribe of Naphtali.

people.name: Zebulun
people.line: Israelite tribe, son of Jacob and Leah

translations.web: He sent messengers throughout all Manasseh, and they also were gathered together to follow him. He sent messengers to Asher, and to Zebulun, and to Naphtali; and they came up to meet them.
translations.bsb: Calling them to arms, Gideon sent messengers throughout Manasseh, as well as Asher, Zebulun, and Naphtali, so that they came up to meet him.
translations.kjv: And he sent messengers throughout all Manasseh; who also was gathered after him: and he sent messengers unto Asher, and unto Zebulun, and unto Naphtali; and they came up to meet
translations.asv: And he sent messengers throughout all Manasseh; and they also were gathered together after him: and he sent messengers unto Asher, and unto Zebulun, and unto Naphtali; and they came up to meet them.
